column1: # ESP32-C3-devkitm-1 partition table with a dedicated recovery/OTA app
# partition so esp_ota_get_next_update_partition() has somewhere to write.
# Arduino Update.h / esp_ota_ops.h flash into that second app slot; main.cpp
# calls esp_ota_mark_app_valid_cancel_rollback() on boot to accept the new
# image. Without this file PlatformIO falls back to the espressif32 default
# (single "factory" app partition) and Update.begin() always fails.
# esptool.py will auto-place the two app partitions after the bootloader.
